headline: Quest Diagnostics confirms data breach exposed patient records
summary: Quest Diagnostics confirmed that patients' personal and health data was compromised after a threat actor gained unauthorized access to its Quanum LSM system. TechCrunch noted Quest is the latest in a series of healthcare technology companies hacked in recent months.

claims.statement: Quest Diagnostics confirmed a data breach exposed patients' personal and health data.
